arguments.message: Yes – you can set up a weekly recurring export that automatically saves the ticket data to a cloud‑storage destination. Just go to **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**, pick the ticket data you want, choose a weekly recurrence, connect your cloud storage provider via the one‑time OAuth connection, and save the schedule. Each run will create a new file in the destination and you’ll see a history of the runs in the scheduled‑exports screen.
